item.title: Iran conflict tests Pakistan amid own border clashes as Islamabad touted as venue for US-Tehran talks
item.summary: Pakistan, the only nuclear-armed Muslim state, faces mounting pressure as its Saudi defense pact and Iran ties clash amid the intensifying regional war.

item.title: Trump turns 2020 statue wars on their head with Columbus monument revival
item.summary: A 13-foot Christopher Columbus replica now stands on White House grounds, replacing the monument rioters tossed into Baltimore's Inner Harbor in 2020.

item.summary: North Andover officer Kelsey Fitzsimmons pleaded not guilty as prosecutors and her defense clashed over a June 2025 gun incident during her trial.

item.summary: Republican Rep. Derrick Van Orden frames Cooke’s environmental group endorsement as threat to Wisconsin agriculture and energy costs in battleground race.

item.summary: Released video shows an Air Canada jet striking a Port Authority fire truck at LaGuardia, killing both pilots and injuring dozens of passengers onboard.

item.summary: Yale athletic director Victoria Chun is accused of creating a "toxic environment" and silencing dissent in a letter former hockey coach Keith Allain sent to Yale's president.

item.title: Chicago lawmaker ripped over 'disgusting' response to college student allegedly killed by illegal immigrant
